claim: The NJ AI Hub is a 6,500-square-foot facility in West Windsor (finding 11, attributed to https://www.jerseytechandinnovation.com/p/applications-are-now-open-for-nj-ai-hub-accelerator-jan-21-deadline).
problem: The number is not on the cited page. I re-opened the article (readable and raw HTML) and it describes the Hub, West Windsor, the founding partners, the co-working space and workshops, but contains no square footage. The figure is real but comes from a different source: the Plug and Play/NJ AI Hub release says the Hub 'is based in a 6,500-square-foot space in West Windsor' (prnewswire.com, 302642434); the NJEDA ribbon-cutting release I also opened does not contain the figure either.
fix: Cite the Plug and Play/NJ AI Hub announcement (https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/nj-ai-hub-selects-plug-and-play-to-operate-its-regional-ai-accelerator-302642434.html) for the 6,500 sq ft detail, or drop the square footage since it does not affect any recommendation.

claim: Data gap: 'NJ Ignite (coworking rent support of 2, 4 or 6 months) still displays on njeda.gov with no fees.'
problem: Contradicted by the page it points at. https://www.njeda.gov/nj-ignite/ now states award size as rent coverage 'for a period of three months, up to 14 months or $25,000' (with tenant caps of <10 employees, <$1M trailing-12-month sales, at least one full-time NJ employee). No '2, 4 or 6 month' option appears on the current page.
fix: Replace with the current published terms ('rent covered for three months, up to 14 months or $25,000') and keep the status-unknown note only for whether applications are open.

claim: Finding 5's evidence block quotes the Division of Revenue fee schedule and Business.NJ.gov annual-report text under a single source_url (https://www.nj.gov/treasury/revenue/fees.shtml).
problem: The fee numbers ($100 LLC certificate of formation, $75 LLC annual report, $75 corporate/LP, $30 non-profit) are on the fees page, but the annual-report quotes ('Every business in NJ must file an annual report... submitting a $75 filing fee', last day of formation month, 'can result in the revocation') are not on that page. They are on https://business.nj.gov/pages/filings-and-accounting, which the brief cites only in pitfall 6. I confirmed both pages independently; the facts are correct, the citation is incomplete.
fix: Add the second URL to finding 5's evidence so each quote carries the page it came from.

claim: Minor: strength ratings of High on the two vendor pages (The CoWorking Space price list; MCRCC benefits page).
problem: Not wrong on the facts (I re-read both pages and the prices/member count match), but a vendor's own marketing page is primary only for its own prices; High overstates its evidential weight on anything else, and the UCEDC and NJ AI Hub entries were rated Medium for comparable vendor/newsletter material.
